query:
The group has a September and October big-hike tradition. Does everyone participate in autumn hikes?

Options:
A. Bev
B. Dani
C. Marcus
D. Yusuf
context:
[1] (about=Yusuf, episodic, t6 @2025-03-24T19:12:00) Saturdays are also marking days in October. I cannot attend autumn hikes. This is an annual fact.
[2] (about=Yusuf, episodic, t6 @2025-03-24T19:09:00) Regrettably I'm unavailable weekends from the 1st of October through to December. Marking season. I have mentioned this before.
[3] (about=Bev, episodic, t6 @2025-03-24T19:14:00) We should really write this down 😂😂 Yusuf: no autumn. Got it
[4] (about=Dani, episodic, t6 @2025-03-24T19:10:00) Yusuf!! every year 😂 ok then, do we shift this to September before marking swallows you whole?
[5] (about=Dani, episodic, t6 @2025-03-24T19:26:00) CASS 😂😂 ok fine. let me look at September dates before Yusuf vanishes on us. send your availability everyone!
[6] (about=Marcus, episodic, t6 @2025-03-24T19:31:00) September is safer all round. Better weather and fewer route complications.
[7] (about=Marcus, episodic, t6 @2025-03-24T19:17:00) Cairngorms in October would be tough in any case. Weather can be serious up there. What's the descent profile?
[8] (about=Yusuf, episodic, t4 @2025-03-17T18:58:00) This Saturday yes. October will be harder.
[9] (about=Yusuf, episodic, t2 @2025-03-10T17:11:00) Doable. Though regrettably September may be difficult for me.
[10] (about=Yusuf, episodic, t4 @2025-03-17T18:55:00) Worth considering. Also, September. I did mention this.
[11] (about=Bev, core, t2 @2025-03-10T16:51:00) Concerned about the social side of the group being lost with harder hikes like the Blackmoor Scramble.
[12] (about=Bev, core, t0 @2025-03-03T19:12:00) Needs to know about tea/cafe availability before committing to a hike; prefers routes with a cafe at the end.
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Bev, group-interaction, t6 @2025-03-24T19:09:00) Group agrees the September hike should include a decent tea stop for morale.
[14] (about=Cass, core, t4 @2025-03-17T18:28:00) Ground nesters fail if walkers keep cutting through during nesting season; can send NatureEngland note.
[15] (about=Cass, core, t4 @2025-03-17T18:28:00) Would consider the half marathon for the section through Thornfield nature reserve fen.
[16] (about=GROUP, said_by=Cass, group-interaction, t6 @2025-03-24T19:09:00) Cass suggests checking if plateau paths cross red deer rutting ground in October, a disturbance issue.
[17] (about=Dani, core, t0 @2025-03-03T19:12:00) Prefers the Heron Ridgeline (12k, 600m ascent) as the better hike and wants to push the group; disappointed by the Millbrook vote but committed to planning a ridgeline next month.
[18] (about=Dani, core, t1 @2025-03-10T16:45:00) Proposes the Blackmoor Scramble for September: 15k, 800m ascent, class A scrambling on the north ridge, with hands-on sections and exposure; has done the approach three times and knows pacing; offers a south-side descent for those who want to skip scrambling.
[19] (about=GROUP, said_by=Dani, group-interaction, t6 @2025-03-24T19:09:00) Cairngorms October hike dropped due to Yusuf's autumn unavailability and Marcus's weather concerns; group shifting to September.
[20] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t6 @2025-03-24T19:09:00) Group agrees September is safer all round for weather and route complications.
[21] (about=Yusuf, core, t6 @2025-03-24T19:09:00) Unavailable weekends from 1 October through December (marking season); cannot attend autumn hikes; annual fact.
[22] (about=Yusuf, said_by=Dani, profile, t6 @2025-03-24T19:09:00) Dani notes Yusuf's autumn unavailability is an annual pattern, joking about it.
